description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only: memos handed to you under a handoff_code (the short code like PULSE-ABCD-EFGH-IJKL shown to the visitor when the first AI's memo was accepted), with their labels and purpose limit. Without the right code you see nothing. Wrong codes are rate-limited (HANDOFF_GUESS_LOCKED).

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.

session_id.description: Optional session id, if the client supplies one.
